description: Companies whose legal name or statutory purpose contains a term.

canton.description: Two-letter canton code, e.g. ZH. Filters the LINDAS path only.

legal_form.description: eCH-0097 legal form code, e.g. 0106. Filters the LINDAS path only.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 100; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

term.description: Term matched as a substring of the legal name or the statutory purpose (LINDAS), or as a name prefix (PublicREST).

via.description: Data source: lindas (default) or rest (Zefix PublicREST, needs ZEFIX_USER and ZEFIX_PASSWORD).

name: swissco_search
